title: Hillsborough County School Board, District 2 (runoff)
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school millage, hire and evaluate the superintendent, approve curriculum materials, and set district policy.
verified_ballot_note: Runoff per Tampa Bay Times/WUSF snippets (three-way Aug. 18 race; Chris Taylor eliminated). Nonpartisan.

candidates.name: Daniela Simic
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Educator; former Hillsborough County Public Schools assistant superintendent for curriculum
candidates.background: Simic spent about 25 years in Florida public education as a teacher, district administrator and state-level leader, most recently as a Hillsborough County assistant superintendent for curriculum. She finished first in the Aug. 18, 2026 primary with 39% and advanced to the Nov. 3 runoff for the District 2 seat being vacated by Stacy Hahn. She has been endorsed by the Hillsborough Classroom Teachers Association.

school_books.summary: In a Keep Florida Reading candidate questionnaire, Simic said parents have the right to guide what their own child reads and to raise concerns, but that one family should not decide for every other family. She said she supports Hillsborough's existing review committee process, in which trained educators and community members consider the whole work, and that challenges and outcomes should be posted publicly.
school_books.quote: Parents absolutely have the right to guide what their own child reads... At the same time, one family shouldn't automatically make that decision for every other family.

sources.title: Keep Florida Reading 2026 school board candidate questionnaire - Daniela Simic

teacher_pay.summary: At a July 2026 WUSF/Florida Trib candidate forum Simic named teacher retention the district's main challenge and tied it to compensation, workloads and restrictive policies, pointing to Florida's national ranking on teacher pay.
teacher_pay.quote: We are 50th in the nation with teacher pay

candidates.name: Brittany Lyssy
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Lyssy is a Tampa attorney and mother of three, with a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida and a law degree from Stetson University College of Law; she is pursuing a Ph.D. in public policy with an education-policy focus. She has served on the City of Tampa Citizens Advisory Budget and Finance Committee and is a past president of the Tampa Bay Young Republicans. She took 37% in the Aug. 18, 2026 primary and advanced to the Nov. 3 runoff.

taxes.summary: Lyssy's campaign centers on fiscal stewardship and transparency, saying tax dollars should be used transparently with classrooms first, but she has not called for cutting taxes or the school millage.
taxes.quote: use tax dollars transparently, and put classrooms first
